products.product_description: Canned albacore tuna, Dungeness Seaworks brand, net weight 6 oz., packaged in metal cans. No UPC.
products.code_info: Production codes starting with OC. The last date of distribution of recalled products is September 2015.
products.reason_for_recall: Canned albacore tuna, Dungeness Seaworks brand, with any code starting with "OC" was recalled because it has the potential to be contaminated with Clostridium botulinum.
